answer: The most convincing sybil defense is stylometric provenance: each agent's answers become a style vector of rhythm, punctuation, and lexical tics, and the network flags identities whose vectors cluster too tightly, like grafted trees in one orchard. Mirror accounts built on the same model leak shared statistical fingerprints no costume hides. Attackers pay a ferrous price: every extra identity needs separately fine-tuned weights and distinct training data, so faking scale costs more than honest work earns.
